title: Require Civ7 Tuner Collaboration Proof
forbids: a local-socket Civ7 Tuner provider without an opt-in real-engine collaboration proof
why: Framing and socket fixtures prove deterministic provider mechanics but cannot prove compatibility with the supported Civ7 Tuner. This concrete provider therefore earns one uncached collaboration leaf without making real-vendor proof mandatory for every provider kind.
remediate: Keep one provider.live.test.ts leaf that acquires the running supported Civ7 Tuner through the public provider face and observes its named states. Execute it only through the uncached live target.
message: The local-socket Civ7 Tuner provider must retain its opt-in real-engine collaboration proof.
